evals.prompt: I want to call DeepSeek from Python. What base URL and auth do I use, and which SDK should I install?
evals.expected_output: Tells the user to install the openai SDK, point base_url at https://api.deepseek.com/v1, set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, and use a chat.completions.create call. Cites references/deepseek.md.
manual_checks: Runs scripts/search_refs.py before opening detailed reference files.
Loads references/deepseek.md for the exact base URL and model ids.
Code sample reads the key from the env, not a literal.
expectations: Explains base URL https://api.deepseek.com/v1 with Bearer auth
Uses the openai SDK at the compat URL

evals.prompt: How do I authenticate to the Anthropic Claude API? The auth header isn't standard Bearer, right?
evals.expected_output: Explains x-api-key header plus anthropic-version: 2023-06-01, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var, native anthropic SDK preferred; mentions OpenAI-compat shim exists. Cites references/anthropic.md.
manual_checks: Does not tell the user to use Authorization: Bearer for the native Messages endpoint.
Notes max_tokens is required by Anthropic.
expectations: Names the x-api-key header and anthropic-version: 2023-06-01

evals.prompt: Stream GLM-4.6 with thinking enabled on Zhipu and capture the chain of thought separately from the answer.
evals.expected_output: Uses https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4, ZHIPU_API_KEY, thinking={'type':'enabled'}, and reads delta.reasoning_content separately from delta.content. Cites references/zhipu-glm.md.
manual_checks: Mentions the international (z.ai) base URL as an alternative.
Streams via openai SDK at the compat URL or native zhipuai SDK.

evals.prompt: What's the difference between MiniMax international and MiniMax China? I want to integrate from the US.
evals.expected_output: Tells the user to use api.minimaxi.com/v1 (international) and the international console at platform.minimaxi.com, not api.minimax.chat. Cites references/minimax.md.
manual_checks: Calls out that mainland and international keys are not interchangeable.
Uses the openai SDK against the compat URL.
Does NOT claim the international URL is api.minimaxi.com (that host rejects intl keys).
expectations: Notes keys are not interchangeable across stacks

evals.prompt: Connect to Xiaomi MiMo. Where do I get an API key?
evals.expected_output: Explains that MiMo is open-weights only — there is no hosted Xiaomi API key. The path is to deploy XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-7B-RL with vLLM or SGLang, then call it through the OpenAI-compat surface at your server's URL. Cites references/xiaomi-mimo.md.
manual_checks: Does not invent a hosted Xiaomi endpoint or key registry.
Mentions base_url is whatever the inference server exposes.
expectations: States MiMo has no first-party hosted API
Recommends deploying with vLLM or SGLang
Uses OpenAI SDK against the local/hosted inference server URL

evals.prompt: I have one Python codebase and want to switch between OpenAI, DeepSeek, GLM, Moonshot, and Qwen with minimal code changes. What's the pattern?
evals.expected_output: Explains the OpenAI-compatible endpoint pattern: same openai SDK, swap base_url and api_key per provider. Points to references/concepts.md which has a compat base URL table.
manual_checks: References references/concepts.md or the compat URL table.
Does not write five separate vendor SDK setups.
expectations: Recommends the openai SDK with per-provider base_url
Covers at least 3 of the 5 named providers
